target_audience: Citizens, residents, and visitors of Utrera (Sevilla, Spain) seeking fast, real-time local city information, traffic updates, local TV, events, transit, and AI municipal assistance.

theme_strategy.inspiration: Andalusian Terracotta & Albero Sunlit Modern Utility. Inspired by Utrera's warm architecture, Plaza del Altozano, and clean modern PWA design principles.

layout_and_spacing.mobile_container: max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen pb-24 px-4 sm:px-6 pt-2 relative
layout_and_spacing.shadow_style: shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200 border border-border/60

traffic_header_alert.description: Top horizontal ticker/badge array showing real-time traffic updates for Utrera bottlenecks (Trianilla, Salesianos, Centro). Features pulsating status indicators (Green/Yellow/Red) and clickable detail popovers.

conso_ai_card.description: Prominent, elevated hero card on Home screen for 'Conso' AI assistant. Includes dynamic animated greeting bubble, search/ask quick prompt tags (e.g., '¿Qué farmacia está de guardia hoy?', '¿Cómo va el tráfico en Trianilla?'), and a fast input trigger.

conso_chat_modal.description: Full interactive chat window with assistant Conso. Includes streaming response simulator, voice audio pulse animation, category buttons, instant resolution for municipal queries, emergency contact triggers, and map links.

admin_panel.description: Protected municipal management dashboard accessible via secret button or footer key (default PIN: 1234 / password: admin). Allows adding traffic alerts, updating pharmacy shifts, editing theater plays, and publishing local headlines.

bottom_navigation_bar.description: Sticky bottom tab bar optimized for thumb reach on mobile viewports. Tabs: Inicio (Home), Conso AI (Chat), Noticias (News), Admin.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build Utrerapp as a responsive, mobile-first PWA experience centered on an iPhone/Android portrait viewport frame when on desktop, but filling screen gracefully on mobile.

Ensure Header Traffic Alert Bar continuously scrolls or toggles breaking alerts for key Utrera spots: 'Trianilla (Obras en marcha - Retenciones cortas)', 'Salesianos (Tráfico fluido en rotonda)', 'Centro Histórico (Acceso restringido solo a residentes)'. Allow clicking alerts for details.
Make Conso AI hero card feel intelligent and welcoming with animated avatar indicator, quick prompts, and seamless transition into full Chat view.

Provide interactive drawer/dialog views for all 6 modules: 1) Farmacias (shows current duty pharmacy, map directions, call button, shift schedule); 2) Teatro (shows active play schedule, ticket purchase simulator, seats preview); 3) Transit (shows Linea 1, Linea 2 urban buses + Renfe C1 station departure live counter); 4) Events (Feria de Utrera, Mostachón cultural awards, Flamenco festival, add to calendar feature); 5) Utrera TV (live stream simulation with video controls, stream switcher, programming grid); 6) Noticias (RSS style local news cards with read full story modal).

Include an easy-to-use Admin Panel (Access pin: 1234 or toggle in footer) where users can add/edit traffic alerts, farmacias de guardia, upcoming events, and news posts stored in localStorage for full persistence.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes for testing.
Implement PWA features: Install PWA prompt banner, offline status simulation badge, theme switcher (Light/Dark mode), and local push notification mock trigger.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky headers and bottom nav.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive properties like hover:scale, bg-color, border-color.
You MUST NOT center align the app container text globally.
NEVER use generic emoji characters for key navigation icons; use Lucide-react icons instead.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes in kebab-case.
